# TigerCli 0.9.5

TigerCli 0.9.5 adds opt-in static shell completion for Bash, Zsh, Fish, and PowerShell, and makes
console output Unicode-safe on Windows without changing the console code page.

## Highlights

- Added `UseShellCompletion()` and the root `--completion bash|zsh|fish|pwsh` option, which prints
  an activation script for the shell.
- Completion is static and metadata-backed: commands, groups, aliases, options, enum and `bool?`
  values, themes, colour modes, and cultures. It follows the parser's grammar, including the `--`
  raw-tail boundary.
- Completion requests never run handlers, factories, contribution callbacks, prompts, or providers,
  and change no console state.
- The PowerShell completer restores `$LASTEXITCODE` and the console encoding, keeps `$Error` clean,
  decodes Unicode descriptions under OEM code pages, and works under Constrained Language Mode.
- Redirected output is UTF-8 on every platform. The interactive Windows console renders Unicode
  through UTF-16, and TigerCli no longer changes the Windows console code page.
- Added the [shell completion installation](https://github.com/rkozlowski/TigerCli/blob/v0.9.5/docs/reference/shell-completion-installation.md)
  contract for installer authors: the generation contract, the Windows PowerShell 5.1/7 lifecycle,
  the PATH requirement, profile management, and ownership of installed artifacts.

## Notes

- Completion is opt-in. With it enabled, `--completion` and `--tigercli-complete` are reserved, and
  `Build()` rejects app or contributed options that use them.
- Regenerate saved completion scripts whenever the app is upgraded.
- PowerShell callers that capture non-ASCII output should select UTF-8 first:
  `[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)`.
- On Windows, `Console.OutputEncoding` reports UTF-16 once TigerCli has applied its output
  contract, and child processes see the console's own code page. See
  [console output encoding](https://github.com/rkozlowski/TigerCli/blob/v0.9.5/docs/reference/console-output-encoding.md).
- Completion has no dynamic, provider-backed values yet. Automatic completion installation through
  TigerSetup is planned, not available yet.

## Packages

- `ItTiger.Core` 0.9.5
- `ItTiger.TigerCli` 0.9.5
- `ItTiger.TigerCli.PngSink` 0.9.5

Each package is published with its symbol package. This release's assets carry the packages, the
licence that applies to them, and `release-artifacts.json` and `SHA256SUMS.txt`, which record every
file's SHA-256 and the commit they were built from.
